# netcup_server_interface (Data Source)

One network interface of a netcup server, including its addresses and their reverse DNS entries (SCP REST API).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netcup_server_interface" "example" {
  server_id = 12345
  mac       = "00:00:5e:00:53:01"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `mac` (String) MAC address of the interface.
- `server_id` (Number) Id of the server.

### Read-Only

- `driver` (String) NIC driver.
- `ipv4_addresses` (Attributes List) IPv4 addresses. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ipv4_addresses))
- `ipv6_addresses` (Attributes List) IPv6 addresses. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ipv6_addresses))
- `speed_in_mbits` (Number) Link speed in MBit/s.

<a id="nestedatt--ipv4_addresses"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ipv4_addresses`

Read-Only:

- `cidr` (String) CIDR.
- `destination_ip` (String) Destination IP.
- `editable` (Boolean) The `editable` value of the SCP REST API.
- `gateway` (String) Gateway.
- `id` (Number) Id of the address.
- `interface_mac` (String) MAC address of the interface.
- `ip` (String) IPv4 address.
- `rdns` (String) Reverse DNS hostname.
- `type` (String) `IP` or `ROUTED_IP`.


<a id="nestedatt--ipv6_addresses"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ipv6_addresses`

Read-Only:

- `cidr` (String) CIDR.
- `destination_ip` (String) Destination IP.
- `editable` (Boolean) The `editable` value of the SCP REST API.
- `gateway` (String) Gateway.
- `id` (Number) Id of the address.
- `interface_mac` (String) MAC address of the interface.
- `link_local` (Boolean) Whether this is a link-local address.
- `network_prefix` (String) Network prefix.
- `rdns` (Map of String) Reverse DNS entries, keyed by full IPv6 address.
- `type` (String) `IP` or `ROUTED_IP`.
